HYBRD is a world-class coach in your pocket for athletes who want to get stronger and faster. Most training plans assume perfect execution. Miss a workout, travel, or get injured, and everything falls apart. HYBRD adapts your training based on your real life, wearable data, and goals, because the best training plan is one an athlete can actually follow. HYBRD provides the personalization and flexibility of a personal coach, without the $300/month price tag.
